title: Handle all valid time stamp resolutions with the -t flag.
description:
Just parse it as a number, and make sure it's in the range of time stamp
values we support.

Also, in the error messages for invalid time stamp types and
resolutions, print just the type or resolution string; that meshes
better with the error messages, and may make it clearer where the prolem
lies.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -183,7 +183,7 @@ and time, as UTC, is the actual time and date the packet was captured
 as YYYY/DOY, and time, as UTC, is the actual time and date the packet
 was captured
 
-*.[N]* Set the precision: N is the number of decimals (0, 1, 2, 3, 6 or 9).
+*.[N]* Set the precision: N is the number of decimals (0 through 9).
 If using "." without N, automatically determine precision from trace.
 
 The default format is relative with precision based on capture format.
